A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''royal attendant''' served as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[King/Legends|King]] [[Regalun Petryph]]. He was present in the [[Royal Hunting Lodge]] and advised Petryph regarding the political crisis on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in [[3627 BBY]].
